1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __embedded in the test tube at a location that is distinct from surface affixation__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP is not directly accessible from the exterior surface of the test tube without removal or destruction of the test tube material__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom surface of the test tube__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the MTP is positioned such that it remains readable after exposure to temperatures of -20°C or lower__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.
